2026-08-07.title: Bihar Govt to Invest 51600 Crore in Industrial Sectors
bullets: The Bihar government has signed MoUs with major industrial groups to invest 51600 crore rupees in the state.
The investment will focus on developing Bihar as a steel hub, along with textile and nuclear energy sectors.
This development is relevant to BPSC and BSSC exams as it highlights the state's economic growth and industrial policies.

2026-08-07.title: Bihar to Develop Historical Sites into World-Class Tourism Centers
bullets: The Bihar government plans to conduct a scientific survey of historical sites like Maa Mundeshwari, Bodh Gaya, SultanGanj, and Mandar.
These sites will be developed into world-class tourism centers, promoting cultural heritage and tourism in the state.
This initiative is relevant to BPSC and BSSC exams as it highlights the state's efforts in preserving cultural heritage and promoting tourism.

2026-08-07.title: Bihar Govt to Mentor 20,000 Teachers
bullets: The Bihar government has launched a new education mission, where 20,000 teachers will be mentored to improve the state's education system.
This initiative aims to enhance the quality of education in the state by providing guidance and support to teachers.
This development is relevant to BPSC and BSSC exams as it highlights the state's efforts in improving education and teacher training.

2026-08-07.title: JP Ganga Path to Get World-Class Infrastructure
bullets: The Bihar government has announced plans to develop the JP Ganga Path into a world-class infrastructure project.
The project will include the development of a 65-kilometer Ganga channel, promoting tourism and economic growth in the region.
This initiative is relevant to BPSC and BSSC exams as it highlights the state's efforts in developing infrastructure and promoting economic growth.

2026-08-07.title: Bihar Govt Signs MoU with Brahmakumari for Nasha Mukti Abhiyan
bullets: The Bihar government has signed an MoU with Brahmakumari to promote the Nasha Mukti Abhiyan in the state.
The initiative aims to create awareness and prevent drug abuse among youth, promoting a healthy and productive society.
This development is relevant to BPSC and BSSC exams as it highlights the state's efforts in promoting social welfare and public health.
